text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, hashlib, pathlib, re
base=pathlib.Path('/Users/eaafonasev/.codex/worktrees/question-quality-wave6-01a12b0f/mindbattle')
out=base/'docs/content-audits/question-quality-wave-8/coordinator-01a16dbc/source-video-game-history27'
C=json.loads((out/'candidate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
S=json.loads((out/'sourceproof.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
P=json.loads((out/'peer-snapshot.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def canon(v): return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
def fsha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def resolve_path(s):
 p=pathlib.Path(s)
 return p if p.is_absolute() else base/p
def pointer(v,p):
 for k in p.strip('/').split('/'):
  k=k.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
  v=v[int(k)] if isinstance(v,list) else v[k]
 return v
entry=C['entries'][0]; se=S['entries'][0]; card=entry['proposedCard']
assert C['sourceNativeId']==S['sourceNativeId']==P['sourceNativeId']=='01a16dd5-8d59-7a70-bb95-3ce750389337'
assert C['topicId']==S['topicId']==P['topicId']=='video-game-history' and C['cycle']==S['cycle']==P['cycle']==0
assert len(entry['fieldGroups'])==6 and len(se['literalGroups'])==6 and len(se['fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments'])==4
assert canon(entry['beforeCard'])==entry['beforeHash']=='ef536449cc33383ca35b28b19023a51404529b2966de959a3151eccfa9019b91'
assert canon(card)==entry['afterHash']
assert (card['id'],card['difficulty'],card['correctIndex'])==('video-game-history-playstation-nintendo-cd-project','hard',1)
assert set(entry['fieldGroups'])=={'prompt_ordered_answers_key','explanation','note0','note1','note2','note3'}
assert all(canon(x['literal'])==x['literalSHA256'] for x in se['literalGroups'])
assert all(canon({'prompt':x['fullPrompt'],'answer':x['answer'],'note':x['note']})==x['tripleSHA256'] for x in se['fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments'])
assert all(x['fullPrompt']==card['prompt'] and x['answer']==card['answers'][x['slot']]['text'] and x['note']==card['answers'][x['slot']]['note'] for x in se['fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments'])
assert all(len(a['text'].encode('utf-16-le'))//2<=140 for a in card['answers'])
assert all(len(a['note'].split())<=35 for a in card['answers'])
assert 2<=len(re.findall(r'[.!?](?:\\s|$)',card['explanation']))<=4 and len(card['explanation'].split())<=70
sourceChecks=[]
for src in S['rawSources']:
 p=resolve_path(src['path']); assert p.is_file() and fsha(p)==src['sha256']
 raw=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')); body=pointer(raw,src['completeOutputPointer'])
 assert isinstance(body,str) and hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest()==src['completeOutputSHA256']
 sourceChecks.append({'path':src['path'],'fileSHA256':src['sha256'],'bodySHA256':src['completeOutputSHA256']})
assert len(P['actualCurrentPeers'])==100 and P['globalMAIN']['questionCount']==11000 and P['globalMAIN']['topicFileCount']==110
assert len(P['relevantProposedPairs'])==7 and all(not x['bilateralMAIN']['duplicate'] and not x['bilateralMAIN']['directReverse'] for x in P['relevantProposedPairs'])
assert P['inventoryFileSHA256']==fsha(out/'fresh-inventory.json')
print(json.dumps({'structuralHashSourcePeerValidation':'PASS','beforeHash':entry['beforeHash'],'afterHash':entry['afterHash'],'sourceChecks':sourceChecks,'fullTopicPeers':100,'mainRows':11000,'bilateralRelevantPairs':7,'frozenFields':'PASS','runtimeQA':'NotRun by assignment','qualityCredit':0},ensure_ascii=False))
PY",max_output_tokens:12000}));
